flags.message: The frozen distribution_count=2 and sal-v4 elevated band include the May 19 distribution for June 4, which appears connected to the motion to proceed as a veteran denied June 8, before August docketing and the August 26 cert distribution for September 28. Thus two entries may not represent a genuine substantive cert relist. I preserved the supplied conditioning and forecast increments from two, but discounted that signal when adjusting the elevated reached anchor.
